mapper.delete: delete from bookmarks where user_id = #{userId} and property_id = #{propertyId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from bookmarks where user_id = #{userId} and property_id = #{propertyId}

select p.property_id, p.address, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent, p.area, p.is_illegal_building, COALESCE( (SELECT ps.safety_score FROM property_safety ps WHERE ps.property_id = p.property_id ORDER BY ps.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0 ) AS safety_score, b.created_at AS bookmarked_at, CASE WHEN p.building_type = 3 THEN '오피스텔' WHEN p.room_type = 2 THEN '투룸' WHEN p.room_type = 1 THEN '원룸' ELSE '빌라/주택' END AS building_type_tag from bookmarks b join properties p on b.property_id = p.property_id where b.user_id = #{userId} AND p.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
